units.does: Broadcast as BLE sensor section with broadcastToggle and footer ('Only active during a workout').

Toggle shown on only when settings.enableZwiftBroadcast AND this device's broadcastAcknowledged (a value restored from iCloud reads off until the disclosure is accepted here); changes go to setBroadcast.

flags.text: The per-device disclosure is gated only on the local @AppStorage flag, but enableZwiftBroadcast lives in UserSettings, which a CloudKit settings restore replaces wholesale; on a new device the restored true value makes workouts start broadcasting HR+power (WorkoutRecorder+Start checks only the setting) without the disclosure ever being shown, contrary to the comment that the explainer must be read once per device.

The toggle only writes the setting; broadcasting starts only at workout start and stops only at workout stop, so turning it off during a recording workout leaves HR+power advertising until the workout ends (and turning it on mid-workout does nothing until the next one).

units.does: Turning on without this device's acknowledgement opens the disclosure sheet and leaves the setting; otherwise writes settings.enableZwiftBroadcast, and turning off also stops a running BLE advertisement (zwiftPeripheralBroadcaster.stopBroadcasting).
